Name: Seasonal Slavic Witch Hut by b0rszcz (farmhouse replacement)
Author: b0rszcz
Description:
I've decided to add something inspired by slavic architecture. Enjoy!

Important note - this mod is loosely inspired by slavic architecture - not it's factual representation. It has it's fragments (I would say, that first house level is quite historically accurate), but majority is just having fun with a concept. You wouldn't find stainglasses in slavic architecture, but it fits witchy vibes well, so it stays, lol. Plz don't treat is as anything serious. 


[b]What this mod adds:
[/b] - New seasonal farmhouse with slavic witch vibes (𝓽𝓸 𝓬𝓾𝓻𝓼𝓮 𝔂𝓸𝓾𝓻 𝓮𝓷𝓮𝓶𝓲𝓮𝓼 𝓲𝓷)

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
- 1.6 update
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko
[/url]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]  [b]or[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]
[/url]

[b]How to Install:[/b]
- Install Content Patcher
- Unzip the file
- Move the folder into your StardewValley/mods folder
- Done!

[b]or[/b]

- Install Alternative Textures
- Unzip the file
- Move the folder into your StardewValley/mods folder
- Use a Paint Bucket (purchasable at Carpenter's Shop)
- Done!﻿
